info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Streaming Subscriptions Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Status API provides real-time visibility into the current status of streaming subscriptions. By utilizing this endpoint, users can retrieve detailed information regarding their subscription activations, which aids in monitoring performance and managing engagement. This functionality is particularly beneficial for businesses leveraging streaming services, allowing them to keep track of subscription activity, ensure seamless delivery, and make data-driven decisions. Typical consumers of this API include analytics platforms, customer relationship management systems, and streaming service providers.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current status of all subscriptions. It provides insights into whether the subscriptions are active, inactive, or pending, enabling better management and monitoring of subscription services.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the current status of subscriptions. Please ensure that the correct JSON structure is followed to ensure a successful response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current subscription status.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusRequest.description: Represents the request body for getting the status of subscriptions.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusResponse.title: Subscription Status Response

status.description: Indicates the success status of the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the subscription request.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the subscription operation.

state.description: The current state of the subscription.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional information or messages regarding the subscription status.

ListStreamingSubscriptionsStatusResponse.description: This schema represents the response structure for the subscription status retrieval operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the subscription.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the subscription was created in ISO 8601 format.

automated.description: Indicates whether the subscription creation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: This schema represents the audit details related to the subscription operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request.
